requirements.subject: ent:omit-operation
requirements.canonical: The `omit` operation IS an operation that checks whether a template instance fulfils the conditions of the omit template restriction.
requirements.original: The omit operation checks if a template instance fullfils conditions of the omit restriction.

requirements.subject: ent:omit-operation
requirements.canonical: The `omit` operation has the syntax `omit` "(" TemplateInstance ")".
requirements.original: omit "(" TemplateInstance ")"

requirements.subject: ent:omit-operation
requirements.condition: the operand fulfils the conditions of the omit template restriction
requirements.canonical: If the operand fulfils the conditions of the omit template restriction (clause 15.8), the `omit` operation IS returning a template with the omit restriction and with the same content as the operand.
requirements.original: A template with the omit restriction and with the same content as the operand, if the operand fulfils conditions of the omit template restriction as described in clause 15.8.

requirements.subject: ent:omit-operation
requirements.condition: the operand does not fulfil the conditions of the omit template restriction
requirements.canonical: If the operand does not fulfil the conditions of the omit template restriction, the `omit` operation SHALL cause an error.
requirements.original: Any other situation shall cause an error.

requirements.subject: ent:template
requirements.canonical: The result of the `omit` operation CAN be safely assigned to a template with the omit restriction.
requirements.original: NOTE: This means that the result of omit(m_myTemplate) can be safely assigned to templates with the omit restriction.

requirements.subject: ent:static-rule
requirements.canonical: The general static rules of TTCN-3 given in clause 5 SHALL apply to the `omit` operation.
requirements.original: General static rules of TTCN-3 given in clause 5 apply.

requirements.subject: ent:present-operation
requirements.canonical: The `present` operation IS an operation that checks whether a template instance fulfils the conditions of the present template restriction.
requirements.original: The present operation checks if a template fullfils conditions of the present restriction.

ambiguity.issue: The operand is a TemplateInstance according to the syntax (and clause 15.12 says 'template instance'), but the sentence says 'template'.

requirements.subject: ent:present-operation
requirements.canonical: The `present` operation has the syntax `present` "(" TemplateInstance ")".
requirements.original: present "(" TemplateInstance ")"

requirements.subject: ent:present-operation
requirements.condition: the operand fulfils the conditions of the present template restriction
requirements.canonical: If the operand fulfils the conditions of the present template restriction (clause 15.8), the `present` operation IS returning a template with the present restriction and with the same content as the operand.
requirements.original: A template with the present restriction and with the same content as the operand, if the operand fulfils conditions of the present template restriction as described in clause 15.8.

requirements.subject: ent:present-operation
requirements.condition: the operand does not fulfil the conditions of the present template restriction
requirements.canonical: If the operand does not fulfil the conditions of the present template restriction, the `present` operation SHALL cause an error.
requirements.original: Any other situation shall cause an error.

requirements.subject: ent:template
requirements.canonical: The result of the `present` operation CAN be safely assigned to a template with the present restriction.
requirements.original: NOTE: This means that the result of present(m_myTemplate) can be safely assigned to templates with the present restriction.

requirements.subject: ent:static-rule
requirements.canonical: The general static rules of TTCN-3 given in clause 5 SHALL apply to the `present` operation.
requirements.original: General static rules of TTCN-3 given in clause 5 apply.

requirements.subject: ent:presentness-conversion
requirements.canonical: The presentness conversion IS the application of the `.present` notation to a general (unrestricted) template, converting it to a template with the present restriction.
requirements.original: The conversion of a general (unrestricted) template to a template with the present restriction can be achieved by applying the .present notation to the template.

requirements.subject: ent:presentness-conversion
requirements.canonical: The presentness conversion has the syntax TemplateInstance "." `present`.
requirements.original: TemplateInstance "." present

requirements.subject: ent:presentness-conversion
requirements.condition: the template expression has no template restriction
requirements.canonical: Applying the presentness conversion to a template expression with no template restriction IS yielding a template with the present restriction.
requirements.original: Applying the presentness conversion to a template expression with no restriction yields a template with the present restriction with the following content:

requirements.subject: ent:presentness-conversion
requirements.condition: the referenced unrestricted template contains AnyValueOrNone
requirements.canonical: If the unrestricted template referenced by the presentness conversion contains AnyValueOrNone, the presentness conversion IS yielding AnyValue.
requirements.original: _AnyValue if the referenced template contained AnyValueOrNone._

readings: If the referenced template is AnyValueOrNone at its top level, the presentness conversion yields AnyValue.
Every AnyValueOrNone contained anywhere in the referenced template (including nested fields) is replaced by AnyValue.
ambiguity.issue: 'contained' does not state whether only the top-level matching mechanism or also nested fields are affected; the top-level reading is assumed, consistent with the present restriction applying to the top level only (clause 15.8).

requirements.subject: ent:presentness-conversion
requirements.condition: the referenced template has the ifpresent attribute attached
requirements.canonical: If the matching mechanism of the unrestricted template referenced by the presentness conversion has the `ifpresent` attribute attached, the presentness conversion IS yielding the same matching mechanism without the `ifpresent` attribute.
requirements.original: Matching mechanism without the ifpresent attribute if the referenced template had this attribute attached to it.

requirements.subject: ent:presentness-conversion
requirements.condition: the referenced template is a template list
requirements.canonical: If the unrestricted template referenced by the presentness conversion is a template list, the presentness conversion IS yielding the template list with all alternatives that evaluate to `omit` removed and with the presentness conversion applied to all other alternatives.
requirements.original: _TemplateList where all the alternatives that evaluate to omit are removed and the presentness conversion is_ applied to all other alternatives.

requirements.subject: ent:presentness-conversion
requirements.condition: none of the other conversion cases applies
requirements.canonical: In all cases other than AnyValueOrNone, a matching mechanism with `ifpresent` and a template list, the presentness conversion of an unrestricted template IS yielding the unchanged template.
requirements.original: Unchanged template in all other cases.

requirements.subject: ent:length-restriction
requirements.canonical: A matching attribute other than `ifpresent`, such as a length restriction, IS NOT affected by the presentness conversion (e.g. `* length(2..10)` is converted to `? length(2..10)`).
requirements.original: NOTE: Other matching attributes such as length are unaffected by the conversion, e.g. * length(2..10) would be converted to ? length(2..10)

requirements.subject: ent:presentness-conversion
requirements.condition: the template expression has the present or value restriction
requirements.canonical: Applying the presentness conversion to a template expression with the present or value restriction IS yielding the same template with the same template restriction.
requirements.original: Applying the presentness conversion to a template expression that has the present or value restriction yields the same template with the same template restriction.

requirements.subject: ent:presentness-conversion
requirements.condition: the template expression has the omit restriction
requirements.canonical: Applying the presentness conversion to a template expression with the omit template restriction IS yielding the same template with the value restriction.
requirements.original: Applying the presentness conversion to a template expression with the omit template restriction yields the same template with the value restriction.

requirements.subject: ent:presentness-conversion
requirements.canonical: Applying the presentness conversion to a template that only matches the special value `omit` SHALL result in an error.
requirements.original: a) Applying the presentness conversion to a template that only matches the special value omit shall result in an error.

requirements.subject: ent:value-extraction
requirements.canonical: The value extraction IS the application of the `.value` notation to a template instance, extracting the underlying value from a `charstring` pattern matching mechanism or from a template with the omit restriction.
requirements.original: The extraction of the underlying value from a charstring pattern matching mechanism or a template with the omit restriction can be achieved with the .value notation applied to a TemplateInstance.

readings: The value extraction applies only to `charstring` patterns and to templates with the omit restriction.

The value extraction applies to any template instance that contains a pattern, a value with `ifpresent`, or a value (as stated in the Semantic Description and Restrictions), irrespective of its template restriction.
ambiguity.issue: The introductory sentence limits the operand to charstring patterns and omit-restricted templates, while 15.15-s005..s008 and the example (an unrestricted var template with ifpresent) accept any template containing a value; the broader second reading is assumed in the other requirements, the first is used here as stated.

requirements.subject: ent:value-extraction
requirements.canonical: The value extraction has the syntax TemplateInstance "." `value`.
requirements.original: TemplateInstance "." value

requirements.subject: ent:value-extraction
requirements.condition: the operand is a pattern of the form pattern StringValue
requirements.canonical: Applying the value extraction to a pattern matching mechanism of the form `pattern` StringValue IS yielding the value StringValue.
requirements.original: Applying this extraction to a pattern matching mechanism of the form pattern _StringValue will yield the value_ _StringValue.

requirements.subject: ent:value-extraction
requirements.condition: the pattern contains a matching attribute
requirements.canonical: If the pattern operand of the value extraction contains any matching attribute, the value extraction SHALL remove that attribute.
requirements.original: If the pattern contains any matching attribute, the attribute shall be removed by the extraction._

requirements.subject: ent:value-extraction
requirements.condition: the template evaluates to Value ifpresent
requirements.canonical: Applying the value extraction to a template that evaluates to Value `ifpresent` IS yielding the value Value.
requirements.original: Applying this extraction to a template that evaluates to Value `ifpresent will yield the value Value.`

requirements.subject: ent:value-extraction
requirements.canonical: Applying the value extraction to a template that contains a value IS yielding that value.
requirements.original: Applying this extraction to a template that contains a value will yield that value.

requirements.subject: ent:value-extraction
requirements.condition: the template contains neither a pattern, nor a value with ifpresent, nor a value
requirements.canonical: Applying the value extraction to a template that contains neither a pattern, nor a value template with an `ifpresent` matching attribute, nor a value SHALL result in an error.
requirements.original: a) Applying the value extraction to a template that contains neither a pattern nor a value template with an ifpresent matching attribute nor a value shall result in an error.

non_requirement.reason: lead-in of the result list; covered by requirements from 15.12-s004 and 15.12-s005
